title: Perfect day : nature, culture and spirituality.

title: Great private tour with Xavier
text: My husband and I took a private tour with Xavier, who was both a great driver and a very informative and knowledgeable tour guide. He shared in depth knowledge of the history, the land, the people, the buildings and the languages spoken. He brought us to the old quarters of each town and gave us information about the architecture and history each village. We felt we were transported to centuries past. We highly recommend this tour!
author: S4787GZjaned

title: Miguel a terrific guide.
text: We had an awesome time with our family of 10.  Miguel is a terrific guide with an excellent sense of humor.  He was extremely knowledgable about the area and was able describe how these towns were populated and its significance to the Catalonia area.  In Vic, Miguel took us to a small bakery for some delicious breakfast and stopped by a local restaurant for lunch in Besalu that served some awesome tapas and paella. Miguel was also an very good driver taking use from our Airbnb to all 3 towns.  I would like recommend booking Miguel for your guided tour of Barcelona.
author: LTLax

title: Fantastic medieval town tour w/ fabulous tour guide
text: We were a large family group of 10 with 2 grandparents in their 80s and 4 teens/young adults. Though Viator allowed up to 8 pax we were able to contact the tour company and add 2 more. title: A nice break from Barcelona.
text: Our guide Xavi was very informative and tailored the visits to the three towns to what we were interested in. With the exception of Besalú, which is visited by many tour buses, we spent our day wandering the quiet Medieval streets on our own. Xavi took us to a quaint tapería in Santo Pau where we had an enjoyable local lunch based on his suggestions. This was a wonderful day spent in some charming locations.
